purpose: Produce a machine-checkable next-trigger design after the first design result was rejected for reopening closed lineages and omitting required design fields.
objective: Using only the supplied repository evidence and finalized adjusted daily OHLCV capability, propose exactly three semantically distinct discrete t0 trigger families that do not reuse the closed MA-cross, price-to-MA reclaim, or price-above-prior/rolling-high breakout predicates. Select exactly one rank-1 candidate. Do not write code, run experiments, choose research acceptance thresholds, or claim profitability.
successCriteria: exactly three machine-parseable CANDIDATE proposal findings are returned
all three candidate featureIds are unique
all three candidate mechanism families are unique
each t0 is a discrete D-1 to D causal transition using finalized adjusted daily OHLCV or deterministic rolling derivatives only
no candidate t0 contains a closed MA-cross, close-to-MA-reclaim, or close-above-prior/rolling-high breakout predicate
each candidate states fields, minimal parameter family, warmup, chart semantics, event-density risk, and distinctness rationale
exactly one RANK1 candidate is selected from the three
exactly one DISCOVERY_CONTRACT next action identifies only the rank-1 feature and parameter search family
Discovery ranking and acceptance gates remain coordinator-owned
constraints: No new data source, API, server, intraday feed, news, fundamentals, order book, or broker state
Do not reuse MA versus MA crossing as a primary trigger
Do not reuse close crossing/reclaiming an MA as a primary trigger
Do not reuse close breaking above a prior or rolling high as a primary trigger
Do not take any closed trigger and add volume, volatility, MA ordering, or another context filter to relabel it as new
Do not invent numeric profitability or acceptance thresholds
Persistent state alone is not a trigger; t0 must be a discrete causal transition
Completed D and earlier information only at t0; executable entry reference remains D+1 open
Do not write implementation code or run Discovery/Validation
